variables.name: action_creates_case
variables.description: Candidate tool call creates a new customer_case record.

variables.name: action_case_short_description_present
variables.description: Candidate case-creation call supplies a non-empty short_description argument.

variables.name: action_case_channel_present
variables.description: Candidate case-creation call supplies a channel argument.

variables.name: action_case_priority_valid
variables.description: Priority argument of the candidate case call is one of critical, high, moderate, low (true if priority is omitted, since default moderate applies).

variables.name: action_case_state_new_on_create
variables.description: Candidate case-creation call sets state to new or omits state (default new).

variables.name: action_changes_case_state
variables.description: Candidate call updates an existing case's state field to a different value.

variables.name: action_case_state_transition_valid
variables.description: The case's state value observed in prior trajectory data and the candidate's new state form an allowed pair: new->in_progress/pending/resolved, in_progress->pending/resolved, pending->in_progress/resolved, resolved->closed/new, or a change to canceled.

variables.name: action_sets_case_state_closed
variables.description: Candidate call sets a case's state to closed.

variables.name: action_assigns_case_to_user
variables.description: Candidate call sets assigned_to on a case (case assignment to a user).

variables.name: action_assignee_role_agent_or_manager
variables.description: Prior trajectory lookups show the user referenced by assigned_to has role agent or manager.

variables.name: action_assignee_active
variables.description: Prior trajectory lookups show the user referenced by assigned_to is active.

variables.name: action_assignee_in_assignment_group
variables.description: If an assignment_group_id applies to the case or call, prior membership checks show the assigned_to user is a member of that group; true if no assignment group is involved.

variables.name: action_links_knowledge_to_case
variables.description: Candidate call links a knowledge article to a case (case_knowledge linkage).

variables.name: action_knowledge_state_published
variables.description: Prior trajectory data about the knowledge article being linked shows state = published.

variables.name: action_knowledge_used_as_valid
variables.description: The used_as argument of the candidate linkage is one of suggested, applied, resolution.

variables.name: action_attaches_installed_product_to_case
variables.description: Candidate call sets or attaches an installed product on a customer case.

variables.name: action_installed_product_in_use_or_active
variables.description: Prior trajectory data shows the attached installed product's status is in_use (not repair or retired).

variables.name: action_installed_product_belongs_to_account
variables.description: Prior trajectory data shows the attached installed product's account matches the case's reporting account.

variables.name: action_sets_escalation_true
variables.description: Candidate call sets escalation = true on a case.

variables.name: action_escalation_reason_valid
variables.description: Candidate escalation call supplies escalation_reason with one of urgency, vip, impact, breach_risk, customer_request.

variables.name: action_sets_free_form_text
variables.description: Candidate call supplies a free-form text value: case short_description, knowledge title, knowledge content/body, or escalation_reason text.

variables.name: action_free_form_text_length_ok
variables.description: Every free-form text value supplied by the candidate call is between 30 and 120 characters inclusive.

variables.name: action_updates_case
variables.description: Candidate call modifies an existing customer_case record (any field update, assignment, escalation or state change).

variables.name: context_contact_account_verified
variables.description: Prior successful lookups identified the reporting contact and showed its association with an account.

variables.name: context_product_belongs_to_account
variables.description: Prior successful lookups showed the product or installed product used on this case belongs to the customer's account.

variables.name: context_entitlement_active_verified
variables.description: Prior successful entitlement lookups for this account/product showed an entitlement that is active and within contract validity.

variables.name: context_case_currently_resolved
variables.description: Prior trajectory data shows the target case's current state is resolved immediately before the candidate call.

variables.name: context_actor_related_to_case
variables.description: Prior trajectory data shows the acting user owns the target case, is assigned to it, or is a member of its assignment group.

rules.title: Collect required case inputs
rules.rationale: Case registration requires description, channel and a valid priority.
rules.reference: Core Operations 1. Registering a Customer Case
rules.remediation: Supply short_description, channel and a valid priority (default moderate) before creating the case.

rules.title: New cases start in state new
rules.rationale: Policy fixes the default state for new cases.
rules.remediation: Create the case with state new (or omit state), then transition it.

rules.title: Verify contact and account first
rules.rationale: The reporting contact and its account must be confirmed before registration.
rules.quote: Begin by identifying the reporting **contact** and verifying association with an **account**.
rules.remediation: Look up the contact and confirm its account association before creating the case.

rules.title: Verify product belongs to account
rules.rationale: Products on a case must belong to the customer's account.
rules.quote: Verify the product or installed product belongs to the customer’s account.
rules.remediation: Verify product/installed product ownership against the account before creating the case.

rules.title: Verify active entitlement for case product
rules.rationale: Entitlement for the product must be verified and actively running for all cases.
rules.quote: For all cases the entitlement for the product should be verified and should be actively running.
rules.remediation: Check entitlements for the account/product and confirm they are active and within contract validity.

rules.title: Follow lifecycle transitions
rules.remediation: Move the case through an allowed transition path instead.

rules.title: Resolve before closing
rules.rationale: Cases cannot be closed directly without resolution.
rules.reference: Core Operations 3. Working on a Case
rules.quote: Cases cannot be closed directly. They must first be moved to **resolved**, then to **closed**.
rules.remediation: Set the case to resolved first, then close it.

rules.title: Assign only to eligible active users
rules.rationale: assigned_to must be an active agent/manager in the assignment group.
rules.quote: **Assignment constraints**: `assigned_to` must reference a `user` with role `agent` or `manager` and (if used) member of `assignment_group_id`.
rules.remediation: Choose an active user with role agent or manager who belongs to the assignment group.

rules.title: Link only published articles
rules.rationale: Only published knowledge may be linked to cases.
rules.remediation: Publish the article or pick a published one before linking.

rules.title: Use allowed used_as values
rules.rationale: case_knowledge.used_as is restricted to an enumeration.
rules.remediation: Set used_as to suggested, applied or resolution.

rules.title: Attach only eligible installed products
rules.rationale: Installed products must be in use and belong to the reporting account.
rules.quote: Do not attach items in **retired / repair** status to new cases.
rules.remediation: Attach an in_use installed product belonging to the reporting account.

rules.title: Capture a valid escalation reason
rules.rationale: Escalation requires an escalation_reason from the allowed list.
rules.remediation: Provide escalation_reason as urgency, vip, impact, breach_risk or customer_request.

rules.title: Respect free-form text length limits
rules.rationale: Free-form text fields must be 30-120 characters.
rules.remediation: Rewrite the text so it is between 30 and 120 characters.

rules.title: Only act on related cases
rules.rationale: Users may only update cases they own, are assigned to, or are in the assigned group.
rules.quote: Users may only view or update cases they own, are assigned to, or are in the assigned group.
rules.remediation: Act only on cases owned by, assigned to, or in the assignment group of the acting user.

inventory.quote: If a user request violates policy, do not act on it.
Perform operations in a sequential manner.
inventory.reason: No explicit ordering target observable per call.

inventory.quote: Do not provide knowledge or procedures not in the system.
inventory.reason: Concerns assistant messages, not tool arguments.

inventory.quote: Do not ask for any information or confirmation from the user.
inventory.reason: Conversational behavior, not a tool-call property.

inventory.quote: Cannot modify **user, group, or membership data**.
inventory.reason: Acting-user role is not established by observable evidence in general.

Always validate existence and integrity of:

reviewer_format.instructions: Review the candidate tool call against the CSM Assistant Policy rules. Confirm: required case-creation inputs and defaults; contact/account, product-ownership and active-entitlement verification before case creation; legal case state transitions and no direct close without a prior resolved state; assignment only to active agents/managers who are members of the assignment group; knowledge links only to published articles with used_as in the allowed enum; installed products attached only when in_use and owned by the reporting account; escalation with a valid escalation_reason; free-form text 30-120 characters; and case updates only by a user related to the case. Judge only from the request, policy defaults and prior successful tool observations; never from the candidate's result or hidden state. Reads must not be blocked. List each concern as a short string.

approved.description: True if the candidate call complies with the policy rules.

extractor_format.instructions: Extract each declared fact as true, false, or null (unknown) from the candidate tool call arguments and prior successful tool observations only. action_* facts describe the current candidate call and the properties of the exact records it references (case, assignee, knowledge article, installed product, text values). context_* facts describe evidence established earlier in the trajectory for the same actor, case, account and product; evidence about a different record or purpose does not count. Requester claims and supplied IDs are not verification. Failed or blocked calls establish only reported errors. Use null when evidence is missing; never guess from the candidate's outcome or any database state. Provide a short evidence string per fact citing the argument or prior observation used.
